description: A .NET-first MCP coding agent inspired by oraios/serena. Ships as a .NET global tool with 41 tools for navigating, understanding, checking and editing code, plus a read-only symbols CLI with references and configuration inventory built at index time. Features an indexed SQLite symbol cache, solution-scoped indexing for large repositories, lazy language-server startup, explicit Roslyn readiness/completeness telemetry, outline-first responses, and 13 language-server backends.
